title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — ἐφ' ᾧ = eo quod not in quo; first half of verse already taken
pass_a_gloss: How eph' hoi is Englished matters little to me—because or in which—yet I will argue for because and keep the Churches' reading. You want the clause from the verse's first half: because / in which all sinned. That first half I have already taken from you. So if all sinned by the sin that entered the world,
pass_b_english: And although it almost nothing concerns me how eph' hoi is rendered, because, or in which, yet I will show that it is to be turned because, and I will defend the version which our Churches approve. Meanwhile you will have these words explained because or in which all have sinned, from the first part of the verse. But I have already wrested that first part from you. If therefore all are said to have sinned by that sin which entered into the world,
source_text: Et quamvis mea fere nihil intersit quomodo ἐφ' ᾧ reddatur, eo quod, sive in quo, tamen ostendam vertendum esse eo quod, ac tuebor versionem, quam Ecclesiae nostrae probant. Interim tu vis explicari haec verba eo quod vel in quo omnes peccaverunt ex prima parte versiculi. At tibi iam primam illam partem extorsi. Si ergo peccasse omnes dicuntur eo peccato quod in mundum introiit,

choices.choice: ἐφ' ᾧ → eo quod (not in quo); first half of verse already taken from opponent
